summary: No thesis broke today. No price stop tripped, and no held name has a new 8-K, guidance cut, failed trial, auditor change or confirmed cyber incident in the inputs. The day was broad de-risking with no news behind it: equity fell 0.89% (-$5.58), SPY fell about 1.0%, the shadow fell about 1.2%, and no held-name headline explains any move. The open WMT 8-K 5.02 question from 11-16 now looks answered: the 11-16 headline 'Walmart Appoints Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed to Board of Directors' matches the filing (document dated 11-13). That match is an inference, but the filing reads as a board appointment, not an executive departure. Two things are tight going into the next two sessions. VOO and VTI (about 23.4% of equity together) closed only 0.4% above their shared SPY 200-day stop (SPY 732.44 vs 729.58), with Nvidia reporting after tonight's close. MCO fell 4.3% to 3.1% above its $470 stop, and nothing in the input explains the drop.
